question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

In the long run
solution:
The correct answer is **'Ultimately'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'In the long run'** is **'Ultimately'.**
 
• **In the long run:** after a long time; in the end. (लंबे समय के बाद; अंत में)
 
 
• *Example: He realized that **in the long run**, their argument wouldn't seem so awful. *
 
 
 
• **Meaning of Ultimately ***- *finally; in the end.
 
• ​Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Answer:__*** **Ultimately.*
